name: backend_intern_good_fit
description: Student with FastAPI/PostgreSQL projects applying to a junior backend role; strong fit with one clear gap (Kubernetes).
job_description:
Junior Backend Developer (Remote, EU)

We are looking for an early-career backend developer to join our platform team.

Requirements
- 1+ years of experience with Python web frameworks (Django or FastAPI)
- Solid SQL skills and experience with relational databases, PostgreSQL preferred
- Comfortable with Git and code review workflows
- Familiarity with Docker for local development
- Experience with Kubernetes is a plus
- Good written communication skills in English

What you will do
- Build and maintain REST APIs
- Write unit and integration tests
- Participate in code reviews
resume:
Jane Doe
Computer Engineering student, 4th year

Experience
- Backend Intern, Acme Corp (Jun 2025 - Sep 2025): Built REST endpoints with Python and FastAPI, designed PostgreSQL schemas, and wrote pytest unit tests for the order service.
- Teaching Assistant, Data Structures (2024): Led weekly lab sessions for 40 students and wrote weekly feedback emails in English.

Projects
- Inventory Tracker: FastAPI backend with SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL, React frontend; containerised with Docker Compose for local development.
- Open-source contributions: Reviewed and merged pull requests on GitHub for a small CLI tool.

Skills
- Python, FastAPI, SQL, PostgreSQL, Git, Docker basics, pytest
